newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-INTER V SCHALKE UEFA CUP FINAL TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-INTER V SCHALKE UEFA CUP FINAL TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for the UEFA Cup final second leg between Internazionale Milan of Italy and Schalke 04 of Germany at the San Siro stadium on Wednesday:

Inter - 1-Gianluca Pagliuca; 2-Giuseppe Bergomi, 19-Massimo Paganin, 7-Salvatore Fresi, 3-Alessandro Pistone, 8-Paul Ince, 21-Ciriaco Sforza, 4-Javier Zanetti, 6-Youri Djorkaeff, 9-Ivan Zamorano, 23-Maurizio Ganz.
Schalke - 1-Jens Lehmann, 10-Olaf Thon, 2-Thomas Linke, 25-Johan de Kock, 4-Yves Eigenrauch, 3-Radoslav Latal, 20-Jiri Nemec, 6-Andreas Mueller, 19-Michael Bueskens, 24-Marc Wilmots, 11-Martin Max.
